title: Postdoctoral Research Scholars (Computation and Machine Learning, Chemical Physics, Nano-science, Biophysics, Statistical Physics)
institution: National Center for Theoretical Sciences (NCTS), Physics Division
field: Computational physics, machine learning, chemical physics, nano-science, biophysics, statistical physics
about: Taiwan's NCTS Physics Division in Taipei invites applications for several postdoctoral research positions in high-performance computation and machine learning, chemical physics, physical chemistry, nano-science, biophysics, and statistical physics and complex systems. Applications close on 31 March 2027.

upskill.name: Machine Learning - Foundations & Methods I
why: "High-performance computation and machine learning" → "Supervised learning: classification, regression, decision trees, SVMs, ensemble methods"
"Statistical physics and complex systems" → "Unsupervised learning: clustering (k-means, DBSCAN), dimensionality reduction (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP)"
